description: This is a Java test class for the ConceptDrugValidator, containing unit tests for validation and support methods related to Drug objects within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ConceptDrugValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ConceptDrugValidator in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAConceptIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Tests whether the ConceptDrugValidator correctly identifies a Drug object without a specified concept as invalid.

methods.name: supports_shouldRejectClassesNotExtendingDrug
methods.description: Tests whether the ConceptDrugValidator correctly rejects classes that do not extend Drug.

methods.name: supports_shouldSupportDrug
methods.description: Tests whether the ConceptDrugValidator supports the Drug class.
